```yaml
name: Release Precompiled Binaries

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  create-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Validate tag version
        run: |
          TAG=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)
          VERSION=$(grep '^version = "' Cargo.toml | cut -d '"' -f 2)
          if [[ "$TAG" != "v$VERSION" ]]; then
            echo "Tag $TAG does not match version $VERSION in Cargo.toml"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Create draft release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          release_name: Release ${{ github.ref_name }}
          body: |
            This is a draft release containing precompiled binaries.
          draft: true

  build-cli:
    needs: create-release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        target: [linux-x86_64-cpu, linux-x86_64-cuda-11.8, linux-x86_64-cuda-12.4, linux-x86_64-cuda-13.0, linux-aarch64-cpu, macos-arm64-metal]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          profile: minimal
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Install lld
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y lld

      - name: Build CLI
        run: cargo build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Archive artifacts
        run: tar czvf cake-${{ matrix.target }}.tar.gz target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/cake

      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.upload_url }}
          files: cake-${{ matrix.target }}.tar.gz,cake-${{ matrix.target }}.tar.gz.sha256

  build-mobile:
    needs: create-release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        target: [android-aarch64-cpu, ios-arm64-metal]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          profile: minimal
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Install lld
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y lld

      - name: Build Mobile
        run: cargo build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Archive artifacts
        run: tar czvf cake-mobile-${{ matrix.target }}.tar.gz target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/libcake_mobile.*

      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.upload_url }}
          files: cake-mobile-${{ matrix.target }}.tar.gz,cake-mobile-${{ matrix.target }}.tar.gz.sha256
```
